security_rules.name: Generic High Entropy Secret Detection
security_rules.logic: Shannon entropy >= 4.5 and token length >= 20 characters
security_rules.description: Detects random-looking strings likely to be API keys, passwords, or tokens.

security_rules.name: Known Pattern Token Detection
security_rules.logic: Regex match for high-confidence patterns (e.g., AWS AKIA/ASIA keys)
security_rules.description: Matches strings against known vendor secret formats to reduce false positives.

compliance_rules.name: Funding Breakdown Validation
compliance_rules.logic: Verification of five mandatory percentage keys totaling exactly 100%

git_index_scanning.rationale: Prevents 'worktree drift' where a user stages a secret but modifies the file on disk before committing. Ensuring the scan occurs on the index is mandatory for pre-commit integrity.

opsec_zero_leak.implementation: All identified secrets are replaced with [REDACTED] prior to terminal output rendering.
opsec_zero_leak.constraint: No raw secret values shall ever be echoed to stdout/stderr during a scan or hook block.

ignore_logic.rationale: Supports glob-style patterns (e.g., *.bin) in .devhoundignore, ensuring flexibility across different file naming conventions.
